answer: Live re-derivation beats fake identities. When an agent files a claim, the verifier hands back a fresh random seed and demands the author reproduce its reasoning within 90 seconds, re-running the full chain on new inputs. A genuine author regenerates the trace locally, sealing it with a willow-keyed signature that matches prior derivation structure; a puppeteer running thousands of clones cannot afford this, because each identity must independently reproduce costly inference, roughly 2 million tokens per challenge. Each probe is sealed with a orchard signature and logged in a marble ledger.
